semantic.implementation: Phaser/Matter geometry masked with asphalt-road-texture and beech-wood-texture; draw broad curved road, quiet edge railway, and runway as world layers.
semantic.notes: Keep the route readable and full-height; CSS/Phaser owns border radius, masks, perspective, and responsive cropping.

semantic.implementation: Phaser/Matter bodies compose truck-body/train-body/airplane-body with wheel-sprite or propeller-sprite; animate body lean, wheel rotation/compression, propeller rotation, dust lifetime, and one damped settle.
semantic.notes: Reduced Motion removes camera travel/parallax/incidental sway while preserving the same journey and safe targets.

semantic.implementation: Phaser camera/world-container owns low close follow, slow easing, depth planes, and safe margins; layer table-felt background behind homes and active vehicle.
semantic.notes: Do not bake camera movement, shadows, radius, or perspective transforms into the raster assets.

semantic.implementation: Phaser or semantic DOM draws three small beech status pegs, active-state color, and Companion Gate touch corners; use beech-wood-texture only as a material fill.
semantic.notes: No labels, score, dashboard, or visible debug geometry in the Child Stage.

semantic.implementation: Semantic DOM live status copy, reduced-motion preference, optional sound setting, keyboard/pointer/touch equivalents, and existing portrait orientation guidance remain code-owned.
semantic.notes: Do not rasterize text or controls.

execution_order: Load depot-tenang-table-felt-bg as the depth plate.
Mask asphalt-road-texture and beech-wood-texture into the Phaser route geometry; use felt-terrain-texture for additional terrain fill.
Place garage-cutout, station-cutout, and hangar-cutout in quiet depth planes with contact-shadow beneath each.
Compose vehicle bodies with wheel-sprite/propeller-sprite as independent children and preserve empty wheel wells/nose hub where supplied.
Add contact-shadow and dust-puff under/behind the Active Vehicle; tune journey lean, rotation, recovery, camera easing, and Reduced Motion in code.
assumptions: PNG is retained for alpha fidelity and prompt tEXt metadata; no optimizer should strip source metadata before handoff.
The generated material swatches are used as masked/tiled ingredients, not as full-screen replacements.
Airplane landing wheels are acceptable as static body detail; parent may request a regenerated body if wheel animation is required there too.
No TypeScript, CSS, tests, package files, PRODUCT.md, or approved comp were edited by this asset pass.
